event_description: A partner successfully creates a new property listing (server-side).
A partner submits a draft listing to go live for admin review (client-side).
An admin approves a pending-review listing to make it available (client-side).
A partner hard-deletes a listing and its photos (server-side).
A partner bumps a listing to refresh its sort position (client-side).
A partner confirms whether a listing is still available, reserved, or rented (client-side).
A partner creates a new contact/lead record, optionally linked to a listing (server-side).
A partner deletes a contact and unlinks their deals (server-side).
A partner links a contact to a listing, creating a deal pipeline entry (server-side).
A partner saves a social-media post draft caption for a listing (client-side).
A partner or admin generates an invite link for a new team member (client-side).
A new team member accepts their invite and joins the studio (client-side).
A partner successfully completes the Facebook OAuth flow and connects their Page (server-side).
A partner disconnects their Facebook Page integration from the studio (client-side).
A partner saves their personal profile (name, photo, phone, WhatsApp, email, bio) in Settings (server + client).
A partner uploads a new profile photo to storage in Settings (client-side).
A partner clears their profile photo in Settings before saving (client-side).
